description: Edit prose to remove the patterns that mark a text as machine-written, in English or Brazilian Portuguese, without changing its meaning and without adding a fact. Explicit only. Use this skill when the user asks for it by name ("unslop this", "/unslop", "run unslop on the README", "passa o unslop nesse texto"), or when another skill tells you to apply it to prose that skill produced. Do not use it for a general request to write, review, improve, shorten, translate, or proofread a text.
